title: Testing the Tester: Why Holistic LLM Judges Reward Broken Answer Keys—and How Contrastive Boundary Pinning Fixes Them
description: Reproducible 400-run (80 verbatim cases x 5 experimental arms) benchmark under an exact 5x5 cyclic Latin square evaluating inference-time ALFA attribute checklists (arXiv:2502.14860) and unguarded Pass-2 rewrites against Register-Decoupled Contrastive Boundary Pinning (CBP, grounded in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English), monotonic blind-solver gating, unfactored rationale stems (arm-3-cbp-rationale-stem), and Factored 2x2 Speaker x Reason grids (arm-4-cbp-factored-2x2) across clinical medicine (MediQ, MedQA-USMLE), K-12 school curricula (Class 6-10), and 1st/2nd-year university STEM, law, economics, finance, and history.
